def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remainder = bins % item
    return np.where(bins >= item, -remainder, -np.inf)

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    rem = bins - item
    valid = rem >= 0
    priorities = np.full_like(rem, -np.inf)
    # For bins that can accommodate the item, compute item_size / remaining_capacity
    # This emphasizes bins where the item takes up a larger fraction of the remaining space
    priorities[valid] = item / rem[valid]
    return priorities

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    remaining = bins - item
    valid = remaining >= 0
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    close_fit = np.abs(remaining[valid] - item)
    # Use log-scale to emphasize small deviations near perfect fit
    priorities[valid] = -np.log1p(close_fit)
    return priorities
